documentation_timing: specified and executed after the Revision-17 review
confirmatory_status: sensitivity evidence; not preregistered or confirmatory

title_specific_group_fold_svm.group_definition: connected components of ISOT title pairs with character-5-gram Jaccard at least 0.80; unconnected titles are singleton groups
title_specific_group_fold_svm.selection: same 12-configuration nested macro-F1 tuning grid used in the equal-budget analysis
title_specific_group_fold_svm.model_scope: Linear SVM only, because it is the manuscript's principal title-transfer model

source_clustered_bootstrap.primary_missing_hostname_policy: pool missing hostnames into one cluster
source_clustered_bootstrap.secondary_missing_hostname_policy: treat each missing-hostname item as a unique cluster

hostname_seen_unseen.seen_definition: the normalized hostname appears in at least one fold other than the item's own five-fold diagnostic fold
hostname_seen_unseen.scope: fixed title models and hostname-only diagnostic
hostname_seen_unseen.interpretation: descriptive subgroup diagnostic, not source-disjoint validation

external_cleaning_sensitivity.model: fixed ISOT-trained title-only Linear SVM, C=1
populations: same-label exact-deduplicated rows with conflicting titles retained

decision_rule: interpret consistency or material change descriptively; do not add these analyses to the earlier exact-test multiplicity family because no new null-hypothesis test is introduced
